segments.text: This is amoxicillin, five hundred milligram capsules, for your chest infection.
Take one capsule every eight hours, with or without food.
It may cause diarrhoea or a rash. Tell us if you get a rash.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
Avoid alcohol while you are taking these.
